description: Terraform security check — Offline static audit of Terraform HCL before apply: internet-exposed admin/database ports in AWS security groups, GCP firewalls and Azure NSGs, public S3/GCS/Azure storage, public or unencrypted RDS/EBS, IMDSv1, IAM Action * / Resource *, hardcoded secrets and AWS keys, plain-HTTP load balancers, unpinned modules. Pass text= (HCL) or url= (.tf file; GitHub blob links converted to raw). Returns verdict PASS/REVIEW/FIX BEFORE APPLY/BLOCK, score, grade and findings with line numbers and fixes. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description: resource "aws_security_group" "web" { ingress { from_port = 22 to_port = 22 protocol = "tcp" cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"] } }

name: security_terraform_check
